data.notes_barbara:
Different core products; Different functional buyers; Limited knowledge-management overlap

eGain primarily supports customer-service knowledge and customer interactions, while Paylocity focuses on payroll and employee management. Shared AI or knowledge features do not establish a direct payroll/HCM match.
data.notes_matthew: eGain is customer service knowledge software for contact centers at banks and telecoms. It's also under $100M in revenue. No human resources overlap.

data.reason: Paylocity sells HCM, payroll, HR, finance and IT software to employers, covering payroll processing, tax filing and workforce management. eGain sells AI knowledge management and customer service automation software to contact centers. The products solve different problems. Paylocity's buyer is HR and finance at mid-sized employers. eGain's buyer is customer service and CX at large enterprises and government. Both sell cloud software, but that is the only link.
Different customers and applications: eGain automates external customer service and contact-center knowledge, while Paylocity supports internal workforce and administrative functions.
